ipointer.title: Connect iPointer
ipointer.description: For some cars, such as the Tiggo 8 PHEV, the Chery Connect service sends fixed battery values. The iPointer app has the real battery level, electric range and charging state. Submit to send an SMS code to the phone number already configured, using the vehicle already configured. Your car needs an iPointer service; signing in here may sign the iPointer app on your phone out.

ipointer_disconnect.title: Disconnect iPointer
ipointer_disconnect.description: Stop reading the battery data from iPointer. The battery entities will show the Chery Connect values again, or disappear if Chery Connect does not report them.
